subject: Air freight quote request – PVG
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to PVG (Shanghai, CN), including truck collection from our site in postcode 70275 (Stuttgart), Germany, and transport to the departure airport?

The machine parts will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-26. The shipment consists of 12 pieces, with a gross weight of 1091 kg and a total volume of 3.27 cbm.

Please provide your all-in price in EUR, along with the earliest pickup and arrival times you can offer.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in quote for a new air freight shipment to Shanghai.
